The open floor plan flows effortlessly from a fireplaced living room into a well-appointed kitchen featuring Corian countertops and a handy office nook, perfect for remote work. Step directly from the kitchen onto the deck overlooking a lush perennial garden - a private retreat fully fenced for kids and pets. A first-floor laundry room and updated half bath add everyday ease. Upstairs are three bedrooms and two baths, including a generous primary suite with en-suite bath and walk-in closet. The finished ground floor includes a fourth bedroom and full bath - ideal as an au pair suite, home office, gym, or private guest space. Additional highlights include solar panels, abundant storage, and a rare 2.5-car garage. All this just a block from the Green Street Orange Line station and moments from JP's eclectic shops, restaurants, parks, and green space - an exceptional combination of historic charm, neighborhood living, and easy access to downtown Boston.

Built in 2017 with nearly 5,000 square feet across four floors, this Parkside residence lives more like a single-family home than a condo. Moments from Franklin Park's 500 acres of trails, meadows, golf, and canopy paths, offering a setting that feels more Vermont than Boston while close to all that Jamaica Plain has to offer.

address: 196 Chestnut Ave Apt J, Boston, MA
text: At the corner of Chestnut Avenue and Spring Park Avenue, this three-level townhome is a commuter's dream with a dedicated parking space and the Orange Line two blocks away. Wood floors run through the main level, where the living room flows into the dining area and double sliders open onto a private deck for grilling, open-air meals, or a slow hour with a book. Wind your way up the sundrenched stairwell tower to the primary suite that feels like its own retreat with a walk-in closet and ensuite full bath. The spaces has plenty of room for a King bed and is rounded out by a Juliet balcony letting in fresh air and natural light. Two additional bedrooms and a second full bath give flexibility for guests, a home office, or creative work, while a second deck extends the outdoor living space. Full-size laundry in the unit and central air offer modern conveniences that can be hard to find in JP but the real draw here is the location. Stony Brook station, the Southwest Corridor, and the restaurants and shops of Centre Street are all nearby, making this the perfect spot for work or play!

address: 107 Saint Rose St Unit 1, Boston, MA
text: On a tree-filled hilltop near Arnold Arboretum, this condo with two bedrooms plus den includes parking, garden space, and so much storage. As you enter, a bright, roomy foyer with two closets welcomes you. In classic form, the living room with a bank of south-facing windows leads into a formal dining room adorned with wainscotting and three windows facing sunset. From there, the remarkably spacious kitchen includes a pass-through pantry with two counters and glass-front cabinetry. The kitchen's induction stove, extensive granite counters and cherry cabinetry, including floor-to-ceiling and drawer storage, will accommodate all the cooking projects you can whip up. From the kitchen, head out via the exclusive deck to pick herbs from your raised garden bed. Also from the kitchen, float downstairs to a 120 sq ft room with exposed vintage wood ceilings that can serve as a den, office/studio or guest space. This level also hosts a 200 sq ft exclusive storage room where you can stash everything you need out of sight. Back on the main level, the hallway to the bedrooms and bathroom includes both laundry and linen closets for everyday ease. The primary bedroom offers two closets, including a walk-in. In addition to the high-efficiency heat pump for forced-air cooling and heating, a boiler with Nest thermostats provides back-up comfort. Enjoy recessed lighting throughout. This unit's parking space includes an EV charger. In Jamaica Plain's Arborway area, find daily serenity in the arboretum. Blocks to Centre/South Street shops, with Happy Market, Jadu cafe, Vee Vee restaurant, Monumental Market, Papercuts Bookshop, and the public lawn at Loring Greenough House. Just half a mile to Forest Hills T.
